Backend test_iter15_pause_uid.py 8/8: unique persisted preview_uid (20001/20002 stored on project docs, db.counters n=2, restart=1 reuses same uid); preview uid gets PermissionError on /app/memory (0700), test_credentials.md, /etc/supervisor/conf.d (0700) + both .conf files, /app/backend/.env; stop=pause keeps .venv + backend files, a doc written before stop is still there after next run (count equal), re-run after pause took ~1.8s; 4 concurrent public POST /run after stop -> ['starting','installing','starting','starting'] (no 'stopped'); sandbox regression (platform mongo blocked, own DB only, other dir/DB unreadable); DELETE removes dir, preview DB and p_{pid} user; smoke /api/me, /api/models, project CRUD. LIVE PREVIEW (fresh browser context, /p/{id}/live): paused backend -> run responses 'starting' + 'installing', then status poll 'running' and iframe auto-shows 'pong do backend UI' after ~4s; never-run backend (cold venv) -> 2 runs + 3 polls, auto-shows real /api response after ~12s. WORKSPACE regression: 'Back-end rodando', iframe shows /api/ping response, Reiniciar -> 'Instalando dependências…' -> back to rodando, route bar /sobre works, Celular toggle -> iframe ~266px, Desktop -> 671px. Docs: docker-compose.yml (MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD=${MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD:?}, credentialed MONGO_URL), .env.example and DEPLOY_VPS.md mention MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD consistently. NEW BUG FOUND: stopping (pause) or deleting a project while its backend is still 'installing' leaves an orphan uvicorn running forever (untracked, survives DELETE).

critical.issue: pause()/stop() pop RUNNERS[pid] and kill st['proc'], but proc is still None while pip installs. The _install_and_launch thread keeps its reference to the popped dict, so it goes on to Popen uvicorn. The process is never tracked: status says 'stopped', the reaper never sees it, and DELETE doesn't kill it either (the dir gets removed while the process keeps running). Reproduced with test_iter15_stop_during_install.py: stop 1s after run, and 45s later uvicorn pid 8918 was still alive after delete (I killed it by hand). The same race applies to ensure(force) / an env change while installing: old['proc'] is None, so the old thread also launches and you get two uvicorns. Fix: put a 'cancelled' flag or generation id in st, set it in pause/stop/ensure-replace, and in _install_and_launch check `RUNNERS.get(pid) is st and not st.get('cancelled')` before Popen and after binding; if the check fails, kill proc. Also run the kill under the per-project lock.

minor.issue: While a force restart is in _kill_proc/sync_files, RUNNERS[pid] still holds the old state. A concurrent call then gets {status:'running', old token} even though that proc is being killed. This is short-lived and harmless for LivePreview because the token changes and tick refreshes.

`docker compose exec mongodb mongodump --archive=... --db donas` has no credentials. Now that the mongo needs MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD, it fails with an authentication error. Add `-u donas -p "$MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD" --authenticationDatabase admin`, or `--uri`.
As documented, `python -S`/bash /dev/tcp can still bypass the Python-level guard in this pod. In the VPS the platform mongo now requires a password.
